content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Offers payroll, HR outsourcing, benefits administration and PEO services to employers, closely matching Barrett's core business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage earning carrier commissions; it places coverage rather than running PEO, payroll or HR outsourcing."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Customer experience and contact-center outsourcing for large enterprises; no payroll, HR, PEO or insurance overlap."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Managed care and claims cost containment for payers; it does not provide PEO, payroll, HR or insurance underwriting."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Insurance claims adjusting and settlement services for insurers; it does not sell PEO, payroll or workers' comp coverage."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Franchised agencies selling personal and commercial insurance placements; no PEO, payroll or HR outsourcing."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Temporary staffing and payroll for temporary workers serving small businesses overlaps Barrett's staffing line, though it lacks PEO and insurance."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Consulting and revenue cycle managed services for healthcare and universities; not PEO, payroll or workforce administration."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Freight trucking, intermodal and brokerage for shippers; a transportation business with no HR or insurance overlap."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Building mechanical, electrical and controls installation and maintenance; physical facilities work, not HR or staffing services."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Commercial and personal insurance brokerage and program administration; it does not provide PEO, payroll or HR outsourcing."}]}
